summary: Shopfront kerb on busy Moggill Road where cars park, but exposed with morning no-stopping.
reasons: No homes, only shops and supermarket

drivers.seclusion: Shops sit right on the footpath; no dwellings nearby, but passers-by and traffic see everything.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line the kerb, so a van can pull in beside them; the stretch is 42 m long.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial next to a signalised junction; buses and heavy traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here under 1/4P and 1P daytime limits; a 7-9am and 3-7pm no-stopping sign applies, so leave before 7am.

flags: Steeper to the east end: about 7% max
sun_shade: Shopfronts shade the kerb in the morning; open to the south sun in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the no-stopping sign covers the best section on site

best_section.where: north kerb of Moggill Road outside the shopfronts east of the western junction
